items.exampleEn: You can merge your two accounts by clicking this button.

items.audioEn: Please put old batteries in the red box for safe disposal.
items.audioZh: 請把舊電池放進紅色箱子，以便安全處理。

items.sentenceEn: Repetition is the key to remembering new words.
items.sentenceZh: 重複是記住新單字的關鍵。

items.sentenceEn: Turn off the TV; it's a distraction when you're doing homework.
items.sentenceZh: 把電視關掉；你寫功課時它會讓你分心。

items.stemEn: After a few small ____, the engineers approved the new design.
items.stemZh: 經過幾處小修改後，工程師們批准了新設計。

items.stemEn: Our company will ____ with a larger firm next year.
items.stemZh: 我們公司明年會和一家較大的公司合併。

items.passageEn: Two small cafes on our street decided to merge last spring. After the closure of the smaller one, the owners made some modifications to the bigger shop: they added more seats, painted the walls, and hung colorful decorations from the ceiling. They also took the old chairs away for proper disposal instead of leaving them on the street. One owner's father, who is in his seventies, still comes every morning, invariably at seven, to wipe the wooden tables with a special polish. "His daily repetition of the same work is part of the cafe's charm," says one customer. The only distraction is the loud coffee machine, but nobody seems to mind.
items.passageZh: 我們這條街上的兩家小咖啡店去年春天決定合併。小的那家關掉後，老闆們對大的那家店做了一些改裝：增加座位、粉刷牆壁，還在天花板掛上色彩繽紛的裝飾。他們也把舊椅子運走妥善處理，而不是丟在街上。其中一位老闆七十多歲的父親仍然每天早上來，總是七點準時到，用特別的亮光劑擦拭木桌。一位顧客說：「他每天重複同樣的工作，正是這家咖啡店的魅力之一。」唯一讓人分心的是那台很吵的咖啡機，不過似乎沒有人介意。

questions.questionZh: 兩家店合併後，老闆對大的那家店做了什麼？
options: 換了新咖啡機、重鋪地板
延長營業時間、增加菜單、換新招牌
增加座位、粉刷牆壁、掛上裝飾

questions.questionZh: 店裡唯一讓人分心的是什麼？

items.promptZh: 這條路下週會封閉三天。
referenceEn: There will be a three-day closure of this road next week.
This road will have a three-day closure next week.
rubricZh: closure 是名詞，表示「封閉」（例如 a road closure、the closure of this road 等）
「三天」可寫，例如 three-day（放名詞前）、for three days 等；寫 will be closed for three days 意思也對

items.promptZh: 這兩條河在城市的東邊匯合。
referenceEn: The two rivers merge on the east side of the city.
These two rivers merge to the east of the city.
rubricZh: merge 表示「匯合」，可不接受詞（例如 The two rivers merge… 等）
「城市的東邊」可寫，例如 on the east side of the city、east of the city 等
